title: Replace implementation note link for MaskedMTKNPT with public arXiv version
body:
I uploaded the technical note for the Masked MTK NPT formulation to [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24061), so it makes more sense to reference that stable public version than the previous GitHub-hosted PDF.
